notes: rect_uv is [x, y, width, height] in normalized UV, origin top-left.
petiole_uv is the stem attachment point in each leaf's LOCAL rect space,
where [0.5, 1.0] is bottom-centre. Leaf cards should be anchored here so
the leaf pivots about the point where it meets the vine.
aspect is width/height; keep it to avoid stretching the leaf card.
alpha_fill is the fraction of the rect that is opaque, measured as the mean of
the alpha channel over the rect. Actual leaf area = alpha_fill * width * height.
Required by the coverage metric (IMPLEMENTATION.md SD-METRIC-3).
tier groups leaves by condition: H = healthy (larger, saturated, clean),
W = weathered (smaller, paler, mottled, damaged edges). See SD-LEAF-6.
